0022600118.text: The Memphis Grizzlies (2-0) head to Sacramento for their third game of the season, sitting 2nd in the Southwest and 5th in the West, but Zach Edey is out with an ankle injury and Cedric Coward is day-to-day with a wrist sprain and a game-time decision. The Sacramento Kings (0-2) are still searching for their first win, sitting 4th in the Pacific, 2 games back, and 14th in the West, and they will be without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee). In the 2025-26 season series, the Grizzlies won 3-1, though they lost their most recent meeting 123-114 in Memphis on February 23, 2026, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 series.
